actors.name: Prabhas
actors.bio: The Pan-India Rebel Star celebrated globally for bringing Indian cinema to the international stage with Baahubali, Kalki 2898 AD, and Salaar.
awards: First South Indian Star with Madame Tussauds Wax Statue
actors.highlightQuote: I believe dedication, hard work, and humility will always triumph.

actors.name: NTR Jr.
actors.bio: The "Man of Masses" and Young Tiger of Telugu cinema, globally acclaimed for his electrifying dancing, emotional acting depth, and iconic role in RRR.
awards: 2x Filmfare Awards South for Best Actor (Nannaku Prematho, Yamadonga)
actors.highlightQuote: Every role I take must connect straight from the heart to the audience.

actors.name: Ram Charan
actors.bio: Global Star and Mega Power Star of Tollywood, revered for his commanding screen presence in monumental blockbusters like RRR, Rangasthalam, and Magadheera.
actors.highlightQuote: Discipline and total dedication to storytelling are everything in cinema.

actors.name: Allu Arjun
actors.bio: The National Award-winning "Icon Star" known for his unmatched style, magnetic dance moves, and monumental worldwide popularity with Pushpa.
awards: National Film Award for Best Actor (Pushpa: The Rise - 1st for Telugu Cinema)
actors.highlightQuote: Pushpa ante flower anukuntiva... Fire-u!

actors.name: Mahesh Babu
actors.bio: "Superstar" Mahesh Babu is one of the most charismatic and commercially successful icons in Indian cinema history with evergreen hits like Pokiri and Athadu.
awards: 5x Filmfare Awards South for Best Actor
actors.highlightQuote: Once I commit, I don’t even listen to myself.

actors.name: Nani
actors.bio: "Natural Star" Nani is celebrated for his effortless realism, versatile performances, and passionate dedication to groundbreaking cinema like Jersey and Dasara.
awards: 2x Filmfare Critics Best Actor (Bhale Bhale Magadivoy, Shyam Singha Roy)
actors.highlightQuote: True connection with the audience is the purest reward an actor can receive.

actors.name: Pawan Kalyan
actors.bio: "Power Star" Pawan Kalyan is a cultural phenomenon, celebrated film icon, and political leader with an unparalleled, devoted fan following across the globe.
awards: Filmfare Award South for Best Actor (Gabbar Singh)
actors.highlightQuote: My aim has always been to stand by the people and fight for truth.

actors.name: Chiranjeevi
actors.bio: "Megastar" Chiranjeevi is the supreme titan and cultural trailblazer of modern Telugu cinema, recipient of the Padma Vibhushan and Indian Film Personality of the Year.
awards: 7x Filmfare Awards South for Best Actor
actors.highlightQuote: Cinema has given me life, and my eternal gratitude belongs to the audience.

actors.name: Vijay Deverakonda
actors.bio: The charismatic "Rowdy Star" who took Indian cinema by storm with groundbreaking performances in Arjun Reddy, Geetha Govindam, and Pelli Choopulu.
actors.highlightQuote: I want to live every emotion honestly and create work that resonates forever.

actors.name: Ravi Teja
actors.bio: "Mass Maharaja" Ravi Teja is Tollywood’s embodiment of explosive energy, impeccable comic timing, and relentless resilience with blockbusters like Vikramarkudu.
actors.highlightQuote: Energy and passion are self-created; no one can steal your enthusiasm.

actors.name: Venkatesh Daggubati
actors.bio: "Victory" Venkatesh is the king of family entertainment, beloved for heartwarming drama, evergreen humor, and intense action across four decades.
actors.highlightQuote: Cinema should touch hearts, bring smiles, and unite families together.

actors.name: Nagarjuna Akkineni
actors.bio: "King" Nagarjuna is the timeless trendsetter of Telugu cinema, celebrated for experimenting across diverse genres with Shiva, Annamayya, and Manam.
actors.highlightQuote: Reinventing yourself with every decade is the only way to stay timeless.

actors.name: Nandamuri Balakrishna
actors.bio: "Natasimham" and God of Masses Nandamuri Balakrishna is iconic for thunderous dialogue delivery, roaring action epics, and blockbusters like Akhanda and Bhagavanth Kesari.
awards: 3x Nandi Awards for Best Actor (Narasimha Naidu, Simha, Legend)
actors.highlightQuote: Flute jinka mundu oodu, simham mundu kaadhu!

actors.name: Adivi Sesh
actors.bio: The mastermind of modern Indian thrillers and gripping biographical cinema, renowned for penning and starring in Kshanam, Goodachari, Major, and HIT 2.
awards: Nandi Award for Best Screenplay Writer
actors.highlightQuote: Great writing is the bedrock upon which unforgettable cinema is built.

actors.name: Dulquer Salmaan
actors.bio: Pan-Indian heartthrob praised for his soulful performances in Telugu masterpieces like Sita Ramam, Mahanati, and Lucky Baskhar.
actors.highlightQuote: Stories that cross cultural boundaries are the ones that endure the longest.

actors.name: Naveen Polishetty
actors.bio: The comedic genius and versatile star acclaimed for breakout superhits like Agent Sai Srinivasa Athreya, Jathi Ratnalu, and Miss Shetty Mr Polishetty.
actors.highlightQuote: Laughter is the most honest bridge between an actor and the audience.

actors.name: Siddhu Jonnalagadda
actors.bio: "Star Boy" Siddhu Jonnalagadda redefined Telugu youthful comedy and swagger with the sensational DJ Tillu and Tillu Square franchise.
actors.highlightQuote: Radhikaaa! Confidence and unique character quirks make magic happen.

actors.name: Rana Daggubati
actors.bio: Pan-Indian heavyweight known for playing the fierce Bhallaladeva in Baahubali, Leader, Ghazi Attack, and high-octane action drama.
actors.highlightQuote: Cinema should challenge boundaries, embrace scale, and tell bold Indian stories.

actors.name: Nikhil Siddhartha
actors.bio: Energetic star recognized for content-driven thrillers and mythological adventures including Karthikeya 2, Swamy Ra Ra, and 18 Pages.
actors.highlightQuote: Curiosity and devotion to unique conceptual stories will always find love.

actors.name: Teja Sajja
actors.bio: Former child star turned pan-Indian superhero sensation with the historic global blockbuster Hanu-Man and upcoming epic Mirai.
awards: SIIMA Youth Sensation of the Year
actors.highlightQuote: Rooted Indian culture combined with modern superhero imagination inspires the entire world.

movies.title: SSMB29 (Rajamouli & Mahesh Project)
movies.briefStory: A fearless globetrotting explorer embarks on a treacherous expedition deep into the uncharted Amazonian jungles to uncover an ancient mythological relic that holds the key to mankind's origins.

movies.title: Dragon (NTR31 / Prashanth Neel Project)
movies.briefStory: An enigmatic warlord emerges from radioactive badlands to wage brutal warfare against tyrannical military regimes that destroyed his homeland and slaughtered his loyal clan.

movies.title: Spirit
movies.briefStory: An uncompromising, volatile police officer wages a high-octane war against an entrenched transnational narcotics cartel, dismantling dangerous underground mafias with unyielding physical prowess and psychological grit.

movies.title: Hari Hara Veera Mallu
movies.briefStory: A legendary 17th-century rebel outlaw orchestrates audacious heists against the tyrannical Mughal Empire, stealing hoarded treasures from oppressive rulers to fund a widespread revolution for the impoverished masses.

movies.title: Game Changer
movies.briefStory: An unyielding Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer wages an all-out war against corrupt political systems and election malpractice to restore integrity, accountability, and justice to Indian democracy.

movies.title: Mirai
movies.briefStory: A brave chosen warrior is entrusted with mystical celestial weaponry to protect King Ashoka's ancient nine secret sacred scriptures from an apocalyptic warlord seeking eternal world domination.

movies.title: Sankranthiki Vasthunam
movies.briefStory: An experienced ex-police officer is hired to protect his former girlfriend and her family from a menacing criminal gang, leading to a hilarious yet action-packed comedy of errors during Sankranti celebrations.

movies.title: Daaku Maharaaj
movies.briefStory: A legendary dacoit warrior in the rugged ravines defends oppressed common folk against ruthless imperial forces and corrupt feudal lords, sparking a monumental uprising for liberation and ancestral honor.

movies.title: Vishwaambhara
movies.briefStory: A warrior blessed with celestial energy journeys across mystical cosmic realms to defeat dark supernatural entities and safeguard the sacred balance of the universal multidimensional cosmos.

movies.title: The Raja Saab
movies.briefStory: A charming romantic youth inherits an enigmatic ancestral royal palace, only to discover paranormal entities and an eccentric aristocratic spirit haunting the grand heritage estate.

movies.title: Tillu Square
movies.briefStory: The hilarious DJ Tillu's romantic escapades throw him straight into an international intelligence trap when he falls for a mysterious undercover agent pursuing a notorious underworld arms dealer.

movies.title: Kalki 2898 AD
movies.briefStory: In a desolate post-apocalyptic future in Kasi, the immortal Ashwatthama awakens to protect the unborn tenth avatar of Vishnu, while a cynical bounty hunter Bhairava pursues the pregnant mother for units.

reviews.reviewText: Nag Ashwin blends Indian Mahabharata mythology with futuristic sci-fi seamlessly. Prabhas brings immense charm and the Karna reveal is sheer goosebumps.

movies.title: Saripodhaa Sanivaaram
movies.briefStory: A young man with uncontrollable rage promises his dying mother that he will unleash his temper only on Saturdays, leading to an explosive duel with a psychotic, abusive police inspector terrorizing an entire town.

movies.title: Hanu-Man
movies.briefStory: A simple village petty thief in Saurashtra gains supreme divine powers through Lord Hanuman's celestial blood jewel, rising as a superhero to defend his villagers from a technologically enhanced supervillain.

movies.title: Guntur Kaaram
movies.briefStory: A fierce underworld enforcer from Guntur rebels when his influential politician grandfather demands he sign away all inheritance rights to his estranged mother, fighting tooth and nail to uncover the true mystery.

movies.title: Lucky Baskhar
movies.briefStory: An undervalued and financially strained bank cashier in 1990s Bombay uses his financial acumen to exploit banking system loopholes, accumulating unprecedented wealth before being trapped in a perilous national scam.

movies.title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
movies.briefStory: Pushpa Raj expands his red sandalwood smuggling empire globally across international ports, fiercely defending his crown against ruthless cartel kingpins and an obsessed SP Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat seeking total revenge.

reviews.reviewText: Allu Arjun delivers a thunderous performance of global proportions. The Jathara sequence is pure unadulterated cinematic fire.

movies.title: Devara: Part 1
movies.briefStory: A courageous coastal sea chieftan stands against maritime smuggling cartels to protect his coastal clans, while his timid son must conquer his inner fears to uphold his father's legendary oceanic legacy.

movies.title: Salaar: Part 1 – Ceasefire
movies.briefStory: In the heavily fortified dystopian city-state of Khansaar, an exiled supreme warrior returns to fulfill an unbreakable blood oath made to his childhood friend during a bloody battle for the royal throne.

movies.title: Hi Nanna
movies.briefStory: A devoted celebrity fashion photographer raising his terminally ill six-year-old daughter alone finds their world transformed when an empathetic woman enters their lives, slowly unearthing a deep past connection.

movies.title: Bhagavanth Kesari
movies.briefStory: A stubborn, battle-hardened uncle trains his timid young niece to conquer her past trauma and join the Indian Army, ruthlessly confronting a corrupt corporate magnate who threatens her safety.

movies.title: Dasara
movies.briefStory: In the rugged coal-mining hamlets of Veerlapally, a fearless young coal-thief battles local political tyrants to avenge the brutal slaying of his childhood friend and protect the honor of his widowed love.

movies.title: Virupaksha
movies.briefStory: A man visiting his ancestral village of Rudravanam must unravel a string of terrifying, unexplained occult deaths before an ancient black-magic curse eradicates every single inhabitant inside the locked-down village.

movies.title: Waltair Veerayya
movies.briefStory: A daring Vizag fisherman smuggler is hired by police authorities to travel to Malaysia and bring back an international drug lord, concealing a deep emotional quest regarding his martyred ACP half-brother.

movies.title: Karthikeya 2
movies.briefStory: A curious young doctor driven by science and logic embarks on a dangerous spiritual treasure hunt across Dwaraka and the Himalayas to retrieve Lord Krishna's mythical, lost ancient anklet.

movies.title: Sita Ramam
movies.briefStory: An orphaned army lieutenant stationed in Kashmir receives anonymous romantic letters from a mysterious woman named Sita, sparking an epic, poignant love story that transcends international borders, decades, and wartime separation.

reviews.reviewText: A poetic masterpiece. Dulquer Salmaan and Mrunal Thakur share ethereal chemistry in Hanu Raghavapudi’s classic vintage romance.

movies.title: Major
movies.briefStory: An inspiring, patriotic biographical chronicle celebrating the courage and supreme sacrifice of Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan, who valiantly saved hundreds of hostage lives during the 2008 Mumbai 26/11 Taj hotel attacks.

movies.title: RRR
movies.briefStory: Two legendary real-life Indian revolutionaries form an unshakeable bond while concealing their identities, before destiny thrusts them into a monumental battle against tyrannical British colonial rule in 1920s Delhi.

reviews.reviewText: A visual spectacle of unprecedented scale. Tarak and Charan delivered career-defining performances under Rajamouli’s breathtaking vision. Naatu Naatu and the interval fight are legendary.

movies.title: DJ Tillu
movies.briefStory: An eccentric, flamboyant local DJ in Hyderabad gets entangled in a high-profile murder and extortion conspiracy after falling in love with an enigmatic young woman with a double life.

movies.title: Jathi Ratnalu
movies.briefStory: Three naive and hilarious small-town friends travel to Hyderabad dreaming of lucrative corporate careers, but inadvertently get framed in an attempted assassination conspiracy against a ruthless state sports minister.

movies.title: Pushpa: The Rise
movies.briefStory: A fearless daily wage coolie rises ruthlessly through the ranks of the illegal red sandalwood smuggling syndicate in the dense Seshachalam forests, defiantly clashing with a menacing, eccentric police superintendent.

movies.title: Shyam Singha Roy
movies.briefStory: A contemporary short-film director accused of intellectual property theft uncovers his past life as a revolutionary Bengali communist author and social reformer in 1970s Kolkata who fought against the Devadasi custom.

movies.title: Akhanda
movies.briefStory: When an unscrupulous mining mafia lord exploits tribal lands and endangers an innocent family, a fierce, Shiva-devotee Aghora warrior steps out of the Himalayas to unleash righteous, divine retribution upon the evil forces.

characters.characterName: Akhanda Rudra Sikandar Aghora / Murali Krishna

movies.title: Vakeel Saab
movies.briefStory: An eccentric retired lawyer struggling with personal tragedy returns to courtroom practice to defend three innocent young working women who are falsely implicated in an attempted murder case by influential men.

movies.title: Sarileru Neekevvaru
movies.briefStory: A courageous Indian Army Major on a secret mission in Kurnool steps forward to protect the defenseless family of a martyred soldier from a menacing, corrupt district politician and his henchmen.

movies.title: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
movies.briefStory: A witty young man who grew up enduring a spiteful clerk’s insults discovers his true biological identity as the rightful heir to a massive billionaire empire, gracefully navigating love, family, and corporate rivals.

reviews.reviewText: Allu Arjun’s effortless style, Trivikram’s witty writing, and Thaman’s chartbuster music make this an all-time family entertainer.

movies.title: HIT: The First Case
movies.briefStory: A brilliant police officer battling severe post-traumatic stress disorder works tirelessly to solve the mysterious abduction of a college girl on a highway, racing against time as evidence points uncomfortably close to home.

movies.title: Agent Sai Srinivasa Athreya
movies.briefStory: A witty small-town detective in Nellore investigates an unidentified dead body case near railway tracks, gradually unraveling a massive interstate organ trafficking network and a sinister religious manipulation scam.

movies.title: Maharshi
movies.briefStory: A globe-trotting tech titan and CEO of an American conglomerate returns to rural India to help his struggling college friend, spearheading an inspiring agricultural revolution that empowers underprivileged farmers across the nation.

movies.title: Jersey
movies.briefStory: A failed, thirty-six-year-old former domestic cricketer comes out of retirement against all medical advice to earn enough money for an Indian team jersey gifted to his adoring young son.

reviews.reviewText: Nani gives the performance of a lifetime. The emotional train station celebration scene will move anyone to tears.

movies.title: Rangasthalam
movies.briefStory: A partially hearing-impaired village youth in 1980s Godavari stands fearlessly beside his educated brother to overthrow an oppressive, caste-entrenched local panchayat president who has exploited village farmers for thirty years.

movies.title: Mahanati
movies.briefStory: A biographical chronicle exploring the glorious rise, immense philanthropic generosity, emotional turbulence, and tragic downfall of legendary Indian cinema actress Savitri, told through the eyes of an investigative journalist.

movies.title: Bharat Ane Nenu
movies.briefStory: A young Oxford graduate unexpectedly assumes the responsibility of Chief Minister following his father's demise, introducing revolutionary administrative reforms to enforce citizen accountability and eradicate systemic political corruption in society.

movies.title: Geetha Govindam
movies.briefStory: An innocent, traditional university lecturer is terribly misunderstood as a pervert by an assertive woman on a bus journey, striving desperately to prove his pure character when their families arrange mutual marriages.

movies.title: Aravinda Sametha Veera Raghava
movies.briefStory: The heir to a violent Rayalaseema faction feud loses his beloved father in a bloody clash, choosing the path of peace, reconciliation, and women-led dialogue to end thirty years of bloodshed.

movies.title: Fidaa
movies.briefStory: An NRI doctor from the United States falls deeply in love with a feisty, independent village girl from Telangana, confronting conflicting cultural aspirations and deep emotional attachment to their respective homelands.

movies.title: Arjun Reddy
movies.briefStory: A brilliant surgical prodigy with severe anger management issues spirals into severe alcoholism, drug addiction, and self-destruction after his beloved soulmate is forcefully married to another man by her conservative family.

reviews.reviewText: A raw, uncompromising breakthrough in Indian romance. Vijay Deverakonda delivers a generational performance that made him an overnight phenomenon.

movies.title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
movies.briefStory: Amarendra Baahubali embraces exile for truth and love, setting up an emotional confrontation as his vengeful son Mahendra returns with loyal warriors to defeat the tyrant Bhallaladeva and reclaim Mahishmati.

reviews.reviewText: A masterclass in grand mythological storytelling. Prabhas as Amarendra Baahubali commands the screen with royal charisma, valor, and supreme dignity.

movies.title: Sarrainodu
movies.briefStory: A hot-headed ex-military officer punishes corrupt criminals outside the law, confronting a tyrannical Chief Minister's sadistic son whose reign of terror threatens democracy and innocent lives across the state.

movies.title: Dhruva
movies.briefStory: An IPS officer trainee secretly profiles organized crime syndicates, engaging in a deadly intellectual cat-and-mouse game against a celebrated, corrupt scientist who covertly controls politicians and illicit pharma cartels.

movies.title: Janatha Garage
movies.briefStory: An environmental activist who loves nature joins forces with a legendary auto-mechanic workshop owner in Hyderabad who delivers righteous vigilante justice to help helpless, oppressed citizens.

movies.title: Nannaku Prematho
movies.briefStory: An intelligent London-based entrepreneur uses applied mathematics, game theory, and psychological warfare to bankrupt a deceitful multi-billionaire businessman who swindled his terminally ill father thirty years ago.

movies.title: Srimanthudu
movies.briefStory: The wealthy heir of a massive business empire refuses to inherit his father's fortune, choosing instead to adopt his ancestral neglected village to build schools, hospitals, and basic infrastructure for poor farmers.

movies.title: Baahubali: The Beginning
movies.briefStory: An adventurous tribal youth scales a towering waterfall to find true love, uncovering his royal heritage as Mahendra Baahubali and the tragic betrayal that destroyed his heroic father and the kingdom of Mahishmati.

movies.title: Temper
movies.briefStory: A blatantly corrupt police sub-inspector in Vizag undergoes a powerful moral transformation after witnessing the horrific violation of an innocent girl, risking his own life and freedom to ensure ultimate courtroom justice.

movies.title: Manam
movies.briefStory: A multi-generational Akkineni family masterpiece where a couple tragically killed in an accident reincarnate as modern youngsters, crossing paths with their now sixty-year-old son who strives to reunite them in love.

movies.title: Race Gurram
movies.briefStory: Two brothers who constantly bicker over trivial household matters unite to wage war against a corrupt, murderous politician who attempts to assassinate the elder brother, an upright police officer.

movies.title: Drushyam
movies.briefStory: A humble cable operator uses his encyclopedic movie knowledge to fabricate an impenetrable alibi to shield his wife and daughters after an accidental death threatens their peaceful family life in a small town.

movies.title: Seethamma Vakitlo Sirimalle Chettu
movies.briefStory: Two close-knit brothers with contrasting temperaments navigate family relationships, societal status expectations, and romance in a tranquil Andhra village, anchored by the profound philosophical teachings of their noble, cheerful father.

movies.title: Mirchi
movies.briefStory: A peace-loving architect returns from Italy with an unshakable mission to reform his violent ancestral village by winning over bloody rival faction clans through compassion, goodwill, and irresistible charm.

movies.title: Attarintiki Daredi
movies.briefStory: The billionaire grandson of an ailing tycoon travels undercover to India posing as a humble car driver to reconcile his estranged, stubborn aunt with his grandfather before the elderly patriarch’s eightieth birthday.

movies.title: Gabbar Singh
movies.briefStory: A flamboyant, fearless rural police officer who styles himself after a legendary dacoit locks horns with a cunning local thug aspiring to enter state politics, settling scores with swagger and unconventional policing.

movies.title: Eega
movies.briefStory: A cheerful young man murdered by a megalomaniac tycoon over a love rivalry reincarnates as a common housefly, waging an inventive, relentless, and hilarious psychological war to protect his girlfriend and avenge his death.

reviews.reviewText: Rajamouli proved that imagination has no bounds. A fly seeking revenge turned into one of the most entertaining and inventive movies in Indian cinema history.

movies.title: Julayi
movies.briefStory: An exceptionally sharp and witty youngster foils a massive five-hundred-crore bank robbery masterminded by a notorious criminal syndicate, teaming up with Hyderabad police to outmaneuver the vengeful mastermind.

movies.title: Dookudu
movies.briefStory: A dashing undercover police officer stages an elaborate psychological reality illusion around his ailing politician father who awakened from a multi-year coma, while hunting down the international mobsters responsible for the attack.

movies.title: Leader
movies.briefStory: An idealistic, overseas-educated youth ascends to the role of Chief Minister following his father's assassination, bravely confronting deeply entrenched political corruption to fulfill his vision of an honest, transparent democratic state.

movies.title: Vedam
movies.briefStory: Five distinct individuals from drastically different social backgrounds cross paths inside a high-security Hyderabad hospital during a sudden terrorist siege, discovering bravery, sacrifice, and the true essence of human empathy.

movies.title: Kick
movies.briefStory: An adrenaline junkie who craves excitement in every life decision turns into a phantom masked vigilante robber, stealing hundreds of crores from corrupt politicians to fund life-saving treatments for destitute children.

movies.title: Magadheera
movies.briefStory: A fearless bike stuntman discovers flashes of his past life as Kala Bhairava, the supreme chief warrior of 17th-century kingdom of Udaigarh, who reincarnates 400 years later to reclaim his immortal soulmate.

reviews.reviewText: Rajamouli’s timeless reincarnation epic. Ram Charan’s 100 warriors fight sequence set a gold standard in Indian action filmmaking.

movies.title: Ready
movies.briefStory: A helpful engineering student kidnaps the wrong bride by accident to prevent an unwanted forced marriage, pulling off an elaborate undercover scam inside two warring Rayalaseema faction families to unite them.

movies.title: Jalsa
movies.briefStory: A reformed former extremist guerrilla militant transitions into a carefree gym trainer in the city, but is pulled back into high-stakes danger when an old ruthless faction enemy targets his mentor’s daughters.

movies.title: Yamadonga
movies.briefStory: A greedy, silver-tongued orphan thief gets prematurely sent to the Hindu underworld of Naraka, where he engages in a hilarious high-stakes intellectual battle of wits and arrogance against Lord Yama himself.

movies.title: Bommarillu
movies.briefStory: An overprotected young man suffocating under his overbearing father's micro-managing decisions finds genuine freedom and unconditional joy when he falls in love with an exuberant, free-spirited girl named Hasini.

movies.title: Vikramarkudu
movies.briefStory: A petty small-time thief discovers an abandoned little girl who believes he is her father, leading him to step into the shoes of a fearless martyred police officer to destroy a brutal Chambal warlord.

characters.characterName: ASP Vikram Singh Rathore / Athili Sathi Babu

reviews.reviewText: Ravi Teja as Vikram Rathore is sheer fire on screen. Rajamouli’s intense mass packaging made this one of the most remade blockbusters in India.

movies.title: Pokiri
movies.briefStory: A ruthless street thug operating inside the Hyderabad underworld juggles dangerous contracts between rival mafia kingpins, while harboring an earth-shattering secret identity as an undercover IPS officer dismantling the syndicates.

reviews.reviewText: Puri Jagannadh and Superstar Mahesh Babu created cinematic history. The iconic climax twist redefined Telugu commercial mass cinema forever.

movies.title: Anukokunda Oka Roju
movies.briefStory: A naive young singer mysteriously loses all memory of an entire missing day, suddenly finding herself relentlessly pursued by fanatic cult assassins and an astute police officer investigating an occult conspiracy.

movies.title: Athadu
movies.briefStory: A professional hitman framed for the assassination of a political leader assumes the identity of a deceased stranger in a traditional joint family village while outsmarting an exceptionally sharp CBI investigative officer.

reviews.reviewText: Trivikram’s razor-sharp dialogues paired with Mahesh Babu’s subtle understated charisma make Athadu an evergreen cult classic.

movies.title: Chatrapathi
movies.briefStory: An uprooted Sri Lankan refugee arrives at a harsh port town in Andhra Pradesh, courageously rising against ruthless mob bosses to protect oppressed port laborers while searching tirelessly for his long-lost mother.

movies.title: Mass
movies.briefStory: A fearless orphan named Mass takes on an all-powerful underworld mafia syndicate to avenge the tragic murder of his beloved foster brother and bring absolute justice to the criminal enterprise.

movies.title: Malliswari
movies.briefStory: An unemployed, easygoing Andhra youth working as a bank clerk unexpectedly becomes the personal bodyguard to a wealthy royal heiress who is targeted by greedy relatives for her immense multi-crore inheritance.

movies.title: Varsham
movies.briefStory: Two star-crossed lovers who fall in love during torrential monsoon rains are forcefully separated by a corrupt landlord and a villainous mafia boss, sparking an explosive battle for their reunion.

movies.title: Arya
movies.briefStory: A spirited college youth practices the philosophy of unconditional one-sided love, selflessly supporting the girl of his dreams while helping her navigate relationship struggles with her possessive and arrogant local politician boyfriend.

movies.title: Okkadu
movies.briefStory: A spirited kabaddi player visiting Kurnool for a state tournament rescues an innocent young woman from the clutches of an obsessive faction leader, shielding her inside historic Charminar in Hyderabad.

movies.title: Simhadri
movies.briefStory: A loyal adopted ward devotes his life to serving a respected landlord family in Visakhapatnam, hiding a terrifying vigilante past in Kerala where he protected innocent oppressed citizens from ruthless underworld mafia dons.

movies.title: Tagore
movies.briefStory: A principled physics professor creates a clandestine underground student organization dedicated to ruthlessly kidnapping and executing the most corrupt government officials in society to systematically eradicate systemic corruption.

movies.title: Indra
movies.briefStory: A benevolent feudal lord sacrifices his personal happiness and ancestral heritage to bring enduring peace between two warring Rayalaseema factions by constructing a life-saving water reservoir for parched rural villages.

movies.title: Manmadhudu
movies.briefStory: A misogynistic advertising executive harboring bitter resentment toward women is forced to work closely with a talented new female manager on a picturesque corporate assignment in Paris, slowly healing past heartbreaks.

reviews.reviewText: Trivikram’s timeless dialogue wit and Nagarjuna’s effortless comedic timing make Manmadhudu one of the greatest Telugu rom-coms ever made.

movies.title: Nuvvu Naaku Nachav
movies.briefStory: A lighthearted and charming youth travels to Hyderabad to assist his father's friend with daughter's grand wedding preparations, only to unintentionally fall deeply in love with the outspoken bride-to-be herself.

movies.title: Murari
movies.briefStory: A spirited young scion of a royal Zamindar lineage races against time to break a deadly generational deity curse before it claims his life upon his upcoming holy wedding anniversary.

movies.title: Kushi
movies.briefStory: Two fiercely opinionated college students who cross paths through common friends fall deeply in love, but their overpowering egos and stubborn misunderstandings prevent them from confessing their true romantic feelings.

reviews.reviewText: A visual spectacle of unprecedented scale. Tarak and Charan delivered career-defining performances under Rajamouli’s breathtaking vision. Naatu Naatu and the interval fight are legendary.
Puri Jagannadh and Superstar Mahesh Babu created cinematic history. The iconic climax twist redefined Telugu commercial mass cinema forever.
A raw, uncompromising breakthrough in Indian romance. Vijay Deverakonda delivers a generational performance that made him an overnight phenomenon.
Ravi Teja as Vikram Rathore is sheer fire on screen. Rajamouli’s intense mass packaging made this one of the most remade blockbusters in India.
Rajamouli’s timeless reincarnation epic. Ram Charan’s 100 warriors fight sequence set a gold standard in Indian action filmmaking.
Trivikram’s razor-sharp dialogues paired with Mahesh Babu’s subtle understated charisma make Athadu an evergreen cult classic.
Nani gives the performance of a lifetime. The emotional train station celebration scene will move anyone to tears.
A masterclass in grand mythological storytelling. Prabhas as Amarendra Baahubali commands the screen with royal charisma, valor, and supreme dignity.
